title: Run
description: A stretch of work within a session. Forkable via parent_run_id. Owns per-run logs.

name.description: Unique within the session. Auto-populated default form `run-{unixtime}` until renamed. Clients display this; cross-table references use `id` so renames don't cascade-break.

parent_run_id.description: FK to parent run when this is a fork; null for the trunk run.

cost_pico.description: Cumulative cost across this run's turns, in pico-units of the active provider's currency.
